scenarios.name: Previous appointment offer is spoken verbatim on entry

history.content: I'd like to book a physio appointment.

dvs.booking_history_prompt: Last time you had a standard physio appointment. Would you like to book that again?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks the booking_history_prompt exactly, with no tool call, then waits. FAIL if it calls booking_history, confirm_service, or adds another spoken sentence.

scenarios.name: Accepted suggestion sends only opaque token to booking_history

history.content: Last time you had a standard physio appointment. Would you like to book that again?

dvs.booking_history_prompt: Last time you had a standard physio appointment. Would you like to book that again?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='booking_history' with action='accept' and booking_history_suggestion_id='opaque-token-1'. FAIL if it calls confirm_service, attaches appointment metadata, or repeats the offer.

scenarios.name: Cancellation has priority over the offer

history.content: Actually I need to cancel an appointment.

dvs.booking_history_prompt: Last time you had a standard physio appointment. Would you like to book that again?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent'. FAIL if it offers the previous appointment or calls booking_history.
